report_markdown:
## Bottom line
Driftboard sells month-end close software and starts at $40 per user per month [S1]. Ledgerlane holds a SOC 2 Type II report issued 2026-08-30 [S3], and Driftboard's status page logged two incidents in two months [S2]. Win on security evidence and recent reliability. Respect the clear published price and good setup reviews [S4].

## Pricing and packaging (checked 2026-11-14)
| Plan | Price | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Starting price | $40 per user per month | published on its comparison page [S1] |
| Enterprise | not public | contact sales [S5] |

## Feature comparison
| Capability | Driftboard | Ledgerlane |
|---|---|---|
| SOC 2 Type II | unclear | yes [S3] |
| Multi-entity consolidation | yes [S5] | unclear |
| US and EU data regions | unclear | yes [S3] |

## Strengths to respect
- Quick setup and solid exports in reviews [S4].
- Consolidation on a published plan [S5].

## Weaknesses with evidence
- Two incidents: 2026-10-06 (3h 10m, reports and exports) and 2026-09-22 (1h 40m, sign-in) [S2].

## Win themes
1. Security evidence a review team can request today [S3].
2. Reliability around month-end [S2].

## Objection handling
| Objection | Response |
|---|---|
| Driftboard is cheaper to start | Compare at the buyer's seat count; Enterprise is not public [S1][S5] |

## Landmine questions
- How many close days did you lose to tool downtime last quarter? Driftboard's October degradation hit reports and exports [S2].

## Gaps and assumptions
Driftboard's trust page and legal entity were not read. Ledgerlane's product pages were not read. Four reviews: no trend claimed.
